## Derivation

For a multiplicity-r core, I independently enumerated every subset of the 2r cyclic sectors. A ray position was declared shared exactly when its two neighboring sectors were both occupied. For a vertex of D2-degree d, I selected d shared rays as D2, assigned the remaining shared rays to D1, rejected any word containing a cyclic run of r-1 consecutive D1 rays, and set B equal to the number of D1 rays cyclically adjacent to at least one D2 ray. Reducing these states to (D1,B) summaries gives the relevant maximal-D1 summaries:
r=3: d=0 -> (2,0); d=1 -> (2,2); d=2 -> (2,2); d=3 -> (3,3).
r=5: d=0 -> (6,0); d=1 -> (6,2); d=2 -> (6,2),(6,3),(6,4); d=3 -> (7,5),(7,6).

Because seven D2 edges give total graph degree 14, the local maxima imply D1>=20 only when four vertices have degree 3 and the two remaining degrees sum to 2. Before applying the charging inequality, exactly 375 seven-edge masks meet this maximal-D1 requirement: 180 have sorted degree sequence (0,2,3,3,3,3) and 195 have (1,1,3,3,3,3). Classified by the degree of the multiplicity-5 core, these 375 split as d5=3 for 250 masks, d5=1 for 65 masks, d5=0 for 30 masks, and d5=2 for 30 masks.

In every such case D1 is forced to its maximum 20, hence U=0 and the charging condition becomes B<=15. If the multiplicity-5 core is cubic, its minimum maximal-state B is 5 and the other forced summaries give total B at least 16, so all 250 d5=3 masks fail. If the multiplicity-5 core has degree 1, the forced maxima give B=16, so all 65 d5=1 masks fail. If it is isolated, the forced summaries are four cubic (3,3) states, one multiplicity-3 degree-2 state (2,2), and one multiplicity-5 isolate state (6,0), giving (D1,B,U)=(20,14,0); all 30 such masks pass. If it is the degree-2 core, the multiplicity-3 isolate is forced to (2,0), the four cubics to (3,3), and the multiplicity-5 core can contribute (6,2), (6,3), or (6,4); only the first two satisfy B<=15, so all 30 masks pass, with respectively B=14 or 15.

For any passing degree sequence (0,2,3,3,3,3), remove the isolate. The remaining degree-2 vertex is adjacent to two of the four cubic vertices. Those four cubic vertices have five internal edges, so they induce K4 minus one edge. Degree accounting forces the missing edge to be exactly the edge between the two neighbors of the degree-2 vertex. Suppressing that vertex therefore restores K4. K4 minus one edge has exactly two triangles, neither using the subdivider, so all triangle vertices are cubic multiplicity-3 cores. The count is also forced combinatorially: when the multiplicity-5 core is isolated, choose the multiplicity-3 subdivider in 5 ways and the subdivided K4 edge in 6 ways, giving 30; when the multiplicity-5 core is the subdivider, choose the multiplicity-3 isolate in 5 ways and the subdivided K4 edge in 6 ways, again giving 30.

Finally, at r=3,d=3 with forced summary (3,3), six shared ray positions must be present and three must be D2. The no-run rule forbids two consecutive D1 rays. On a 6-cycle with three D1 and three D2 positions this forces strict alternation, yielding only masks D2=21,D1=42 or D2=42,D1=21. Thus an elementary D2 triangle cannot realize even one of its corners under the declared adjacency premise.

## Verification / falsification hooks

A complete replay needs only: (1) enumerate all 2r sector subsets for r in {3,5}; (2) construct shared boundary rays, D2 choices, D1 complements, no-run rejection, and B exactly as stated above; (3) enumerate all 32768 six-vertex graph masks with the stated lexicographic edge-bit convention and retain masks of popcount 7; and (4) test Cartesian products of local summary sets against U=D1-20>=0 and 5<=2U+D1-B. The resulting 60-mask list and SHA-256 must equal the values given above.

The local r=3,d=3,(D1,B)=(3,3) replay must return exactly the signatures (63,21,42) and (63,42,21). Falsification would be any additional globally feasible seven-edge mask, any passing mask with a different degree structure, any globally feasible triangle vertex summary other than (3,3), any additional admissible local signature with adjacent D2 rays, or a counterexample to one of the declared geometric premises.
